items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Well, I played a couple of times with Jo Jones and another one.

ctx.x: How did you -- did you -- who were some of the drummers that you liked to play with during those years?
Well, I played a couple of times with Jo Jones and another one. I forget his name offhand.

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: because we did that with Slam Stewart

ctx.x: Here we are in 1973 and we're all very happy to redo some of these things and put them down as a matter of record. So now I just want to wish you the greatest. I'm going to miss you, old buddy, because when I don't check in with you once or twice 4 week -

You're not going to miss me because I'm going to get you fired like I always do and you probably will have to come over to join Milt Buckner and myself, because we did that with Slam Stewart and I'm pretty sure that with the friends that we know out here, we can get you fired and have you to come over to join us. (laughs)
I'll send for Slam any day, any week.
